basic_info.description: This spacious one-level residence feels like a single-family home, and is an entertainer's dream with a bright, open floor plan and multiple terraces for seamless indoor-outdoor living. Perfectly positioned on a sunny southwest corner, it is one of the largest homes in this Eichler-designed building. A formal entry leads to a grand open-concept great room, extending to two spacious terraces, perfect for dining and entertaining. All three bedrooms, including the primary suite, open to private outdoor terraces.  Home includes a home office, in-floor radiant heat and in-unit laundry. This elevator building features a 24-hour front desk attendant and tennis courts. Conveniently located just a block from Lower Pacific Heights, Fillmore Street and Japantown, this is within close proximity to restaurants, cafes, and movie theaters. Easy access to public transportation and to area freeways.
